responsibility: Defines the shared backend submodules and exposes the module-level helper that derives the effective LLVM target triple, including Apple deployment-target versioning when required.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-named module roots, this `mod.rs` is only a namespace for backend implementation areas such as archiving, linking, LTO, metadata, and output writing. It does not define core MIR translation state, trait APIs, or analysis helpers; it just groups concrete backend support submodules.
